title: Elon Musk says Tesla plans to wind down production of the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory around mid-2027 "to make room for increased Cybercab production" (Kana Inagaki/Financial Times)
summary: Kana Inagaki / Financial Times: Elon Musk says Tesla plans to wind down production of the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory around mid-2027 “to make room for increased Cybercab production” — Carmaker will wind down production of futuristic pick-up truck at its gigafactory in Texas
